boards.name: BOOST-DRV8711 Stepper Motor BoosterPack
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit implementation of Texas Instruments' BOOST-DRV8711 BoosterPack. The board follows TI's published hardware design and combines the DRV8711 stepper-motor pre-driver with four CSD88537ND dual N-channel MOSFETs.

boards.name: BOOST-DRV8848 Dual Brushed Motor BoosterPack
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit implementation of Texas Instruments' BOOST-DRV8848 revision-A BoosterPack. The board follows TI's published hardware design and uses the DRV8848 dual H-bridge driver to control one or two brushed DC motors from a compatible LaunchPad.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-ADS1119 data-acquisition BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-ADS1119 16-bit analog-to-digital converter BoosterPack. The circuit, fitted parts, four DNP references, values, and functional connections follow TI user guide SBAU322 and its Figure 27 schematic.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-ADS7841-Q1 data-acquisition BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' four-channel BOOSTXL-ADS7841-Q1 data-acquisition BoosterPack. The circuit, fitted and DNP parts, values, and functional connections follow TI user guide SNAU229 Figure 19 and its bill of materials.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-AUDIO audio BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-AUDIO BoosterPack. The electrical design follows TI's official schematic and BOM; the PCB uses TI's exact 58.42 × 76.20 mm outline, recovered Altium component centers, and exact TI 0603 copper geometry.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-BASSENSORS building-automation sensor BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-BASSENSORS Building Automation Sensors BoosterPack.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-CC2650MA tscircuit reconstruction
boards.description: This directory reconstructs Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-CC2650MA CC2650 module BoosterPack in tscircuit. The electrical design follows the Rev 1.0.1 schematic and expanded Allegro netlist in TI's official SWRC324 design package.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM Motor-Drive BoosterPack
boards.description: This project is a tscircuit reference implementation inspired by Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM. It recreates the board's main electrical architecture and LaunchPad XL interface from TI's BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM User's Guide.

boards.name: Educational BoosterPack TS
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit board inspired by TI's BOOSTXL-EDUMKII Educational BoosterPack. It retains the wide, rounded BoosterPack form factor and combines a display, environmental and motion sensors, user controls, audio I/O, lighting, and a servo connector on one LaunchPad XL-compatible board.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-TLV8544PIR tscircuit reconstruction
boards.description: This is an engineering reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-TLV8544PIR PIR motion-detector BoosterPack.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-TMP107 tscircuit reconstruction
boards.description: This project reconstructs the Texas Instruments BOOSTXL-TMP107 BoosterPack in tscircuit. The electrical design follows TI's MHR035 Rev A schematic in the official BOOSTXL-TMP107 user guide. The board includes the LaunchPad headers, selectable UART transmit path, main TMP107, and two breakaway TMP107 sensor nodes.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-ULN2003 dual stepper-motor BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-ULN2003 BoosterPack. The electrical design follows the official SLCU002 schematic and includes the fitted ULN2003 driver path, eighth CSD17571Q2 output, serial/parallel control, mode switches, status LEDs, motor connectors, supply protection, and DNP alternatives.

boards.name: TIDA-00647 ADS1220 RTD BoosterPack
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit implementation of Texas Instruments' TIDA-00647 reference design. The board uses the ADS1220 24-bit delta-sigma ADC to connect two-, three-, or four-wire resistance temperature detectors to a compatible LaunchPad through SPI.
